name: Mobile mechanic (we come to you )

reviews.text: Ran into some seized bolts later in the evening while replacing my brakes and Tony was able to get them out. The timing was not a problem and service was very professional.
reviews.author: Kareem Gordon-Graham

reviews.text: This was the worse experience ever ! I called to have my breaks and rotors fixed and only the breaks were fixed due to mechanic stating he couldn’t get the wheel studs off . He promised to come back on several occasions and I’ve been calling and texting for weeks literally and everytime he will say he’s coming on one day and never show up ! Do not play yourself I should have went to a regular mechanic from the jump !
reviews.author: Basimah Smith

reviews.text: I spent almost $1000.00 to get my car back on the road due to a fuel pump replacement and now my lights are back on. No mention of a refund. Im not happy with my experience.  Communication was not clear. Now i have to take the vehicle to the dealership.  Extra screws were left under tge hood. Also a fuel regulator was installed for no reasons and i was charged 🤦🏽
reviews.author: PiFF PENNY

reviews.text:
I booked this mechanic for 11:00 AM. At 10:55 AM, I got a last-minute text saying they wouldn’t be here until 1:00 PM. Fine, I was patient. But when I called at 2:30 PM, they told me I was their next client. Hours had already gone by. I kept checking in, and eventually got a text saying they were “42 minutes away.” Over an hour later—still nothing. I called again and they had the nerve to send me straight to voicemail. Then say 5 mins away after. At this point I’m scared for them to even touch my car.

Not only were they completely unreliable, but their tone through text was rude and dismissive. I explained I’m a working mom and needed my car fixed today, and they just strung me along all day like my time didn’t matter. What makes it worse is that I could have hired someone else who actually respects their clients—but because they kept promising they were “on their way,” I waited around like a fool.

They cost me an entire day and any chance of getting my car fixed by a real professional. If you value your time or sanity, do not book these people. Unprofessional, inconsiderate, and an absolute disgrace.
reviews.author: Bianca Ditro

reviews.text: Same thing as all the other reviews. Said they’d be there at one time ended up coming four hours later, then came and told me what I already knew was wrong with it and charged me $75 to use a shitty scanner. Asked how much the repair would be got told oh the secretary is gonna call you back with a quote. Never did. Listen to the reviews. Waste of money and time. Go somewhere else.
reviews.author: Zay Conomy
